tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /dpal gshin rje gshed dmar po'i bskyed rdzogs kyi khrid 'chad thabs zab don gsal ba bzhugs so// swasti/ bla ma dang bcom ldan 'das gshin rje'i gshed la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'dir dpal gshin rje gshed dmar po'i man ngag zab mo spros med kyi 'khrid 'chad tshul ni/ gzhung nas bshad pa'i bla slob sogs mtshan nyid dang ldan zhing skabs su babs pa na thog mar ngor chen kun dga' bzang pos mdzad pa'i mngon rtogs bdud rtsi'i bum pa/ dkyil chog bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun/ ngor chen dkon mchog lhun grub kyis mdzad pa'i lhan thabs bdud rtsi'i snying po/ shar chen kun dga' bkra shis kyis mdzad pa'i nag 'gros bdud rtsi'i rol mtsho/ paṇa chen nam mkha' dpal bzang gis mdzad pa'i mtshams sbyor rnams kyi steng nas smin byed kyi dbang bzhi yongs su rdzogs par bskur la/ khrid 'chad pa'i tshe rang gi mdun stegs kyi khar sku bag can gyi zlum gtor mtheb kyus bskor ba'i drung chu gnyis nyer spyod sgrengs tshar dang slob dpon gyi drung rdor dril nang mchod bshams la/ dpon slob rnams 'dus 'phral slob dpon gyi thal mo sbyar la/ bla ma dang bcom ldan 'das dpal rdo rje sems dpa' la phyag 'tshal lo/ /oṃ badzra sa twa sa ma ya sogs de nyid 'dus pa nas gsungs pa'i rdo rje sems dpa'i yig brgya nyer gcig 'ur 'don gyi mthar/ dpon slob thams cad kyi thal mo sbyar la/ phyag 'tshal bstod de sogs nas/ dag par gyur gyi bar sgrub dkyil gyi dbu bzhin/ de nas slob dpon nam gzhan gang rung gis bskul la/ ngor chen dkon mchog lhun grub kyis mdzad pa'i brgyud 'debs khyab bdag 'khor lo'i dbang phyug gshin rje gshed ces sogs la tshar chen yab sras kyis mdzad pa'i 'jigs byed brgyud 'debs blo 'das ma'i gdangs de bcug pa'am ma bcug kyang rung / bcug na lam rim gyi bar gdangs bya/ de nas 'dur ma de grub 'phral slob ma rnams kyi maṇḍal so bdun ma rlon 'bul gyi gong /

las kyi rdo rjes gtor ma chu'am chang gis sbyangs/ maṇḍal 'bul ring la slob dpon gyi gtor ma la rdo rje'i rtses nang mchod 'thor tshul dang / hrīḥṣṭīḥs bsangs/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ lag pa g.yon pa bstan te oṃ/ g.yas pa bstan te āḥ lag pa gnyis phan tshun bsnol te mthe'u chung sbrel/ mthe bong so so'i lag mthil du bkug sor mo lhag ma rnams gshibs te cung zad thur du brkyangs pa 'dab chags spyi'am/ bya khyung gi phyag rgya bstan te hoḥ lag gnyis bsnol te rgyab sbyar ba'i srin lag sbrel/ mthe'u chung dang gung mo gnyis bkug te mthe bong gis mnan/ mdzub mo gnyis bsgrengs pa 'chi med rnam rgyal gyi phyag rgya ste hūm̐ zhes brjod/ lag gnyis thal mo sbyar ba'i srin lag nang du bkug mdzub mo gnyis gung mo'i rgyab nas cung zad ma reg par bkug pa rdo rje rtse lnga pa'i phyag rgya bstan te oṃ āḥhūm̐/ zhes yang yang brjod pas byin gyis brlabs/ 'di rnams kyi bsam bya sgrub thabs na yod/ khu tshur gnyis rgyab sbyar te bsnol ba'i mthe'u chung sbrel/ mdzub mo bsgreng ba lcags kyu ltar bkug la hrīḥṣṭīḥmathar/ oṃ lo ka pā la sa pa ri wā ra a karṣa ya dza/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros pas phyogs skyong 'khor dang bcas pa gtor snod kyi mthar byon te skad cig gis gshin rje gshed kyi skur gyur/ so so'i phyag rgya bcas la oṃ badzra arghaṃ āḥhūm̐/ oṃ badzra pādyaṃ āḥhūm̐ zhes mchod yon dang zhabs bsil phul/ pad kor sngon 'gro'i rdor thal kha phye'i mthar se gol gtog pa dang bcas/ oṃ ind+ra ya sogs lan gsum gyis phul/ oṃ badzra puṣpe āḥhūm̐ sogs kyis mchod/ phyogs skyong 'khor dang bcas pa'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐ zhes dang g.yon pa'i mtheb srin gyis nang mchod phul/ rdor dril gsor dkrol lam thal sbyar gang rung byas la/ bdud bzhi po ni rnam par bcom/ /zhes pa nas yid la 'dod pa kun 'grub shog gi bar/

badzra muḥ mtheb srin gyis se gol phyir gtog bsod nams 'di yis thams cad gzigs pa nyid sogs/ de nas sems bskyed gsal 'debs nas brtsams te 'khrid gzhung dngos la 'jug go /de skabs su khrid yig rgyas bsdus sna tshogs 'dug kyang rang re'i rtsa ba'i bla ma gnas gsar rdo rje 'chang de nyid kyis she'u lo tsā ba byams pa kun dga' chos grags kyis mdzad pa'i khrid yig nang gi mar me bzhin gsan mod/ rang cag la bka' drin skyong ba'i tshe mkhyen brtse'i bskyed rim rnam bshad dang thar rtse paṇa chen gyi khrid yig nges don rdo rje'i them skas/ a mes zhabs kyi 'jam dpal chos kun gsal ba'i nyin byed rnams lhu bsgrigs pa la 'jam mgon de nyid kyi gsung bshad phul phyin bka' drin bskyangs pa yin pas de bzhin nam/ yang na nang gi mar me la spros med mdzes rgyan sbyar kyang rung / shin tu khyer bde zhing 'chad sla ba ni/ mkhyen brtses mdzad pa'i khrid yig nyams rtogs pad dkar bzhad pa'i nyi ma gzhir bzung / khog phub kyi skabs su 'jam mgon a mes zhabs kyi 'jigs byed chos 'byung na gshed dmar skor yang gsal bas de nas rang gi blo gros dang bstun nas blangs la rdo rje 'chang nas rtsa ba'i bla ma'i bar gyi rnam thar rnams kyang rgyas bsdus skabs sbyar rang gis rnam dpyod kyis dpyad la sbyar/ bskyed rim rnam bshad mkhyen brtse'i gsung sor bzhag bla ma sangs rgyas su sgrub pa'i lung rigs dang don yod rnam bzhi'i sgo nas bla ma mnyes par byed tshul gyi bshad pa thar rtse paṇa chen gyis khrid yig sogs nas kha bskangs te 'chad pas rang gis 'chad sla zhing slob ma rnams kyis rtogs sla ba dang yid 'phrog par 'gyur bas phal cher 'di bzhin legs 'dra zhing / rang dang slob ma gnyis char shes rab kyi rtsal rdol ba zhig yod na gshed dmar gyi rgyud dang / rgya bod kyi gzhung tshad ldan mtha' dag la zhib tu dpyad cing gtso bor bla ma mkhas pa'i zhal las nos pa bzhin nor 'khrul med par bshad pas thos bsam gyi sgro 'dogs chod cing sgom 'bras bde blag tu 'byung bar 'gyur bas de ltar shes par byas la rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum gyi sgo nas stabs gang bde byed cing bar mtshams rnams su rgyud dang rgya bod kyi gzhung rnams kyi lung dang byin rlabs kyi rim pa rnams thob tshe skabs bstun gyi bya dgos kyang deng sang ni lung rgyun tho re ba dang dbang 'khrid gnyis ma chad tsam las/

byin rlabs rnams shin tu dkon par snang ngo / /gang ltar de dag gi skabs su bshad pa dang dmigs thun rgyas bsdus kyi mtshams sogs ni blo gros dpyad kyi bya ba las/ gzhan gsung ngag khrid yig sngags 'chang grags blos pas mdzad pa dang / mkha' spyod ma'i khrid 'chad thabs kun mkhyen lnga pas mdzad pa lta bu ni sngar phan ma byung ngo / /chos thun rnams grol mthar bsod nams 'di yis sogs dang / theg mchog dam chos sogs chos bsngo rang gi gang shes byed pa las 'di dgos kyi dmigs bsal ni med do/ /dbang gi dngos gzhi dang 'khrid grol nyin tshogs 'khor bla med spyi 'gre la byin rlabs sogs gshed dmar dmigs bsal sbyar ba tsam khyad par ro// //zhes spros med kyi 'khrid 'chad tshul nyung ngu 'di yang mus chen bsod nams dpal bzang gis bzhed skong du sa skya pa ngag dbang kun dga' blo gros kyis sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni gzhu lung pa'o// //shu bhaṃ// // PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 2 kun dga' blo gros/ dpal gshin rje gshed dmar po'i bskyed rdzogs kyi khrid 'chad thabs/ PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 1
